results.title: Old Guys in Bed
results.overview: A gay film historian enlists his tech-savvy teenage niece to help him pursue the 70-year-old man of his dreams.

results.title: Gerbang Setan
results.overview: Diki, Beni, Rachel, Bagas, and Wina went on a horror trip to Lawase Urip Village after Beni found a mysterious flyer on the campus bulletin board. Upon arriving in the village, they began to feel something strange and unsettling... They thought they were in for a fun adventure, but it suddenly turned into a horrifying terror. The line between real ghosts and fake ones became impossible to distinguish.

results.title: Meteors
results.overview: France's rural wasteland. Mika and Dan have big dreams but little luck. Cornered after another blunder by Dan, they end up working for Tony, their best friend, who's now the king of construction. Mika and Dan need to find a way out of here, a way out of trouble – simply a way out.

results.title: Rui Carlos
results.overview: In the mid-1980s, during a summer day, Rui Carlos and his friends Maranau and Tomané enjoy their free time in the neighborhood, between football matches and playful games. Rui Carlos repairs his worn-out shoes and heads out to borrow a valuable football from their neighbor, Dona Olinda, who daily entrusts it to him. As the teams are chosen and the game begins, typical neighborhood interruptions ensue: a visit from Mascote the dog, a break for lunch, and spontaneous games. But when the ball gets punctured, Rui Carlos is left to face responsibility and the realities of growing up.

results.title: Algo Novo que Contar
results.overview: Xoana spends the summer with some friends, including Emma, a young girl with whom she is having an affair. Xoana is a virgin and is afraid of the idea of moving forward. Her thoughts make it difficult for her to advance in her relationship with Emma.

results.title: The Cure: The Show Of A Lost World (Troxy Live 2024)
results.original_title: The Cure: The Show Of A Lost World (Troxy Live 2024)
results.overview: To launch the album "Songs of a Lost World" on 1st November 2024, The Cure play live at Troxy in London. Playing the album in full, then embarking on a monster set to adoring fans, The Cure show why they are one of the most respected bands of the last 40 years. Main Set: Alone, And Nothing Is Forever, A Fragile Thing, Warsong, Drone:Nodrone, I Can Never Say Goodbye, All I Ever Am, Endsong, Plainsong, Pictures of You, High, Lovesong, Burn, Fascination Street, A Night Like This, Push, In Between Days, Just Like Heaven, From the Edge of the Deep Green Sea, Disintegration, At Night, M, Secrets, Play for Today, A Forest. Encore: Lullaby, The Walk, Friday I'm in Love, Close to Me, Why Can't I Be You?, Boys Don't Cry.

results.title: Memorizing Alison
results.overview: A man with an extraordinary but failing memory tries to solve the mystery of what happened to a woman killed by a hit-and-run driver.

results.title: Brame Techno
results.overview: A summer in the countryside. Guilhem and Anthony are trying to rig up their sound system for a party. Rosa is attempting to attract deer with a life-size sculpture. And the mayor's son is handing out prizes at the annual flea market...

results.title: Yellow Bucket
results.overview: When gay teenager Connor and his parents realise they are able to decide the sexuality of Connor's younger brother, the decision causes a breakdown in communication...

results.title: Waking State
results.overview: After watching a top secret videotape, a small town law clerk must track down the tape's origin and its connection to a deeper conspiracy.

results.title: Bekifftes Deutschland – Zwischen Rausch und Realität
results.original_title: Bekifftes Deutschland – Zwischen Rausch und Realität

results.title: Zameer
results.overview: When questioned about his deceased son, a lonely father decides to drive the media away from the notion of his son’s innocence regarding a recent terror activity.

results.title: Lads
results.overview: Ethan, 20, becomes an apprentice jockey in a racing stable. He discovers a talent, a passion, and begins to dream of a better future. But among the jockeys, places are hard to come by and competition is fierce. Out of a hundred lads, only one will go pro. If he wants to stand out from the crowd, Ethan is going to have to take some risks...

results.title: Paran
results.overview: A heartfelt family drama about Dharmanath, who treasures his children as his “essence of life” and dreams of growing old in their love. Set in Dhankuta, the film beautifully portrays love, legacy, and the true meaning of family.

results.title: Fiori cadono
results.overview: Betty is the owner of the Grand Capitol Hotel, an elegant establishment with retro charm. It is a “jewel” that Betty does not want to see age with her, so she has decided to sell it. Before leaving the hotel, she contacts her granddaughter Emme to spend her last days at the Capitol with her and say goodbye to the hotel with a poolside party.

results.title: Eel
results.overview: Liang’s simple, humdrum life in his deceased father’s dilapidated boathouse on the Shezi island takes a totally unexpected turn when he saves a mysterious young woman from drowning. A woman with her own painful past meets a man haunted by nightmares.

results.title: Stardom in Toyama 2025 Dec.
results.overview: Stardom in Toyama 2025 Dec. was a professional wrestling event produced by World Wonder Ring Stardom, held on December 14, 2025, at the Toyama Industrial Exhibition Hall Techno Hall East Building in Toyama, Japan.

results.title: Love & Gold
results.overview: Two thieves enter the same dungeon searching for a gem worth incredible wealth, but what they find along the way is worth more than all the treasure in the dungeon combined.

results.title: The Journey to No End
results.overview: In the future world, environmental degradation has greatly affected everyone. Most people have to upload their consciousness to live in a data-constructed world called the New World, while some people remain outside to maintain the operation of it. A 16-year-old boy Cheng Qi has lived with his father since his parents divorced. After his father entered the New World, he set off on a journey to find his mother. Along the way, after experiencing all kinds of adventures, Cheng Qi becomes even more confused about what kind of life he truly wants for his future.
